items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: We were so far advanced... They were too far advanced for Arsenio Rodriguez' ear... Harmonically he was not rich, so we was more advanced, musically, than Arsenio really was.

ctx.x: Okay. What did you hear about Arsenio?

Well, he is starting. Naturally, I mean I am telling you the truth. We were so far advanced, as a matter of fact, the Sexteto Bologna, with Latica Gutierrez, Bologna - there was a tres player we used to, they used to play fox trot, we used to play Spanish lyrics. They were too far advanced for Arsenio Rodriguez' ear. Arsenio Rodriguez was very talented because he create something that he could play. He knew his limitation and he never was above his limitation.
But in 1933, had he been playing son montuno yet?
